## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format`, and `mypy` pass locally (or `pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Public API changes are documented (docstrings + docs)
- [ ] A changelog fragment was added under `changelog/` (e.g. `123.feature.md`)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) for the DCO
